Optional request ID for cancellation support (task 1732 α).  When provided: joins a new process group via setsid, writes the pgid to <worktree_base>/.merge_verify_pgids/<request-id> at startup, and removes it on exit (normal or exceptional).  A concurrent ``orchestrator cancel-verify --request-id X`` can then kill the entire descendant tree (including start_new_session build escapes).  Absent → today's exact behavior, back-compat.  RemoteRunner wiring is deferred to tasks β/γ.
